newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Skilled buys Victoria port service firm.
newsitem.headline: Skilled buys Victoria port service firm.

text.p: Skilled Engineering Ltd said on Friday it has acquired Melbourne Port Services Pty Ltd (MPS) for A$7.735 million plus half the proceeds from surplus assets, from the state government of Victoria.

MPS, currently a subsidiary of the Melbourne Port Corp, delivers port services in the Port of Melbourne including mooring, dredging, security and general maintenance. The main MPS surplus assets is the dredging vessel MV Vella.
In a statement, Skilled Engineering's managing director, Frank Hargrave said the company expected to see sales of A$15 million from MPS in its first year under Skilled's control.
"Skilled is targeting the privitisation activities of all the states and the federal government," Hargrave said.
Victoria Treasurer Alan Stockdale said the sale continued the state government's process of introducing private sector expertise into Victoria's port system.
"After the expiry of current contracts, a wide range of important ancillary services in the Port of Melbourne will become open to competition," Stockdale said.
